# The real coordinator has fully stopped before the SAME OPEN DB baseline.
skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id one --wait
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id two --wait
controller quiesce
db-save before.db
skygo --json jobs retention
db-unchanged before.db
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z
stdout '"inspected": *2'
stdout '"selected": *0'
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout '"skipped": *2'
stdout '"executed": *false'
stdout 'proof_required'
db-unchanged before.db
# The one-record cleanup budget is simulated across the entire page.
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal
stdout '"inspected": *2'
stdout '"selected": *1'
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout '"skipped": *1'
stdout 'cleanup_full'
stdout '"executed": *false'
! stdout 'must-not-appear'
db-unchanged before.db
assert-native 0
assert-output 0
# Materialize a real taskless manual header, then rejoin ALL writers.
controller start
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --page-size 1 --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
controller quiesce
skygo --json jobs retention
json-value admin.obligations.0.id OBLIGATION
db-save manual.db
skygo --json jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout '"selected": *0'
stdout 'cleanup_full'
stdout '"executed": *false'
db-unchanged manual.db
assert-native 0
assert-output 0
